new_news.headline: Barrel Energy Q1 2026: Revenue $42.4K, Net Loss $6.18K, EPS $(0.01)
new_news.summary: Barrel Energy filed Q1 2026 10-Q results showing revenue of $42.4K and net loss of $6.18K (EPS -$0.01), a swing from prior-year net income of $16.86K. The company reported going concern doubts and disclosed material weakness in internal controls.

new_news.headline: Clean Harbors Q1 2026 Earnings: Beat EPS, Missed Revenue
new_news.summary: Clean Harbors reported Q1 2026 EPS of $1.19, beating the $1.15 estimate, but revenue of $1.46B missed the $1.47B forecast by 0.51%. The company raised full-year 2026 Adjusted EBITDA guidance to $1.24–1.30B, citing strong Environmental Services margin expansion and PFAS-related demand growth.
